title: Predictive Modeling Project Context
summary: Project Context completed with business objective, intended use, target definition, population definition, observation window, and performance window.

payload.businessObjective: Support appraisal review by estimating median home value for a census block group from public housing-census attributes.
payload.intendedModelUse: An appraisal analyst uses the estimated value as a reference point alongside comparable sales; the model output does not replace a licensed appraisal.
payload.targetDefinition: The median home value (in hundreds of thousands of dollars) for owner-occupied housing units in a census block group.
payload.populationDefinition: All California census block groups with complete housing and demographic attributes reported in the source housing census extract.
payload.observationWindow: Block-group housing and demographic attributes (income, age of housing stock, occupancy, location) available at the census extract date.
payload.performanceWindow: The median home value as reported in the same census extract; there is no separate outcome-maturation delay for this attribute.
